description.value: Grocery Checkout is a grocery store operated by the UBC Alma Mater Society (AMS), located on Level 1 of the AMS Student Nest building on the UBC Vancouver campus. It focuses on healthy, locally-sourced, and socially conscious foods at affordable prices. Its central campus location makes it a convenient resupply stop for cyclists exploring the UBC peninsula.

address.value: Level 1, 6133 University Blvd, UBC Campus, Vancouver BC, V6T 1Z1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 55m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 95m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Grocery Checkout is an AMS-operated supermarket at Level 1 of The Nest, 6133 University Blvd, UBC campus, specializing in healthy, locally-sourced, and socially conscious foods. No bike parking, water refill, hot food, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content. Basic groceries are confirmed by the store's core identity and product description.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; address derived from website footer, phone is the AMS main office line (not a store-direct number).
Phone number (604) 822-2901 is the general AMS office line and may not reach Grocery Checkout directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed, operating grocery store on the UBC campus with a clear website and physical location; a practical resupply point for touring cyclists riding through UBC.
